url: Official AnkiDroid manual and in-app menus
description: Hand-verified capability inventory for AnkiDroid (com.ichi2.anki), version 2.24.0.

features.name: Create a deck
features.description: Create a deck as documented for AnkiDroid.

features.name: Create a subdeck
features.description: Create a subdeck as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: enter the name using the "Parent::Child" notation (for example "Spanish::Verbs")
tap OK; the deck is nested under the parent

features.name: Rename a deck
features.description: Rename a deck as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: long-press the deck (or tap the gear icon on the deck row)

features.name: Delete a deck
features.description: Delete a deck as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: long-press the deck (or tap the gear icon)
confirm; the deck and its cards are removed

features.name: Reorder or re-parent decks
features.description: Reorder or re-parent decks as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: change the "::" prefix to move it under a different parent

features.name: Study a deck
features.description: Study a deck as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap one of the answer buttons (Again, Hard, Good, Easy) to grade the card

features.name: Add a note (create cards)
features.description: Add a note (create cards) as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: fill in the fields (for example Front and Back)

features.name: Create a cloze deletion card
features.description: Create a cloze deletion card as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: set the note type to Cloze
type the sentence in the Text field
tap the cloze ([...]) button in the field toolbar

features.name: Attach an image, audio clip or recording to a field
features.description: Attach an image, audio clip or recording to a field as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap the paper-clip/multimedia icon beside a field
confirm; the media reference is inserted into the field

features.name: Create an image occlusion note
features.description: Create an image occlusion note as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: select the Image Occlusion note type
draw the masks over the areas to hide
add optional header and comment text

features.name: Add tags to a note
features.description: Add tags to a note as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: Open the Add or Edit note screen
select existing tags or type a new tag

features.name: Edit an existing card or note
features.description: Edit an existing card or note as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: While reviewing, tap the edit (pencil) icon; or open the Card Browser and tap the card

features.name: Preview a card
features.description: Preview a card as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: step through the question and answer sides with the navigation arrows

features.name: Browse and search cards
features.description: Browse and search cards as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: type an Anki search query (for example "deck:Spanish tag:verb is:due")

features.name: Filter the Card Browser by deck, note type, flag or tag
features.description: Filter the Card Browser by deck, note type, flag or tag as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: select a deck, note type, tag, flag or saved search from the sidebar

features.name: Save a search in the Card Browser
features.description: Save a search in the Card Browser as documented for AnkiDroid.

features.name: Flag cards with colours
features.description: Flag cards with colours as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: Open the Card Browser and select cards (or tap the flag icon during review)
choose the flag colour (for example red, orange, green, blue, pink, turquoise, purple)

features.name: Suspend or unsuspend cards
features.description: Suspend or unsuspend cards as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap "Toggle Suspend"; suspended cards are shown greyed out and are skipped during study

features.name: Bury a card or note
features.description: Bury a card or note as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: During review tap the overflow menu
tap "Bury card" or "Bury note"; the item is postponed to the next day

features.name: Reposition new cards
features.description: Reposition new cards as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: enter the start position and step

features.name: Set a card's due date
features.description: Set a card's due date as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: enter the number of days or a range
choose whether to change the interval

features.name: Reset/forget cards
features.description: Reset/forget cards as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: choose whether to restore the original position

features.name: Change the deck of selected cards
features.description: Change the deck of selected cards as documented for AnkiDroid.

features.name: Change the note type of selected notes
features.description: Change the note type of selected notes as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: map the old fields and templates to the new ones

features.name: Delete cards or notes
features.description: Delete cards or notes as documented for AnkiDroid.

features.name: Undo the last action
features.description: Undo the last action as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: Tap the undo arrow in the toolbar (available on the reviewer, the Card Browser and the deck list)

features.name: Configure deck options (scheduling)
features.description: Configure deck options (scheduling) as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap the gear icon on the deck row
set the new cards/day limit, the maximum reviews/day, the learning steps, the graduating and easy intervals, the lapse steps, the leech threshold and action, the burying options and the display order

features.name: Enable and configure FSRS scheduling
features.description: Enable and configure FSRS scheduling as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: optionally tap "Optimize" to compute parameters from your review history

features.name: Create a filtered/custom study deck
features.description: Create a filtered/custom study deck as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: choose the option (for example increase today's new card limit, review forgotten cards, study by card state or tag)
set the search, limit and order

features.name: Rebuild or empty a filtered deck
features.description: Rebuild or empty a filtered deck as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap "Rebuild" to refill it with matching cards, or tap "Empty" to return the cards to their home decks

features.name: View study statistics
features.description: View study statistics as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: select the scope (deck or collection) and the period (for example 1 month, 1 year, all history)
scroll the graphs (Future Due, Calendar, Reviews, Card Counts, Card Ease/Difficulty, Hourly Breakdown, Answer Buttons, True Retention)

features.name: Synchronise with AnkiWeb
features.description: Synchronise with AnkiWeb as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap the sync icon in the toolbar
enter the AnkiWeb email address and password on first use
the collection syncs; tap sync again later to sync manually

features.name: Synchronise media
features.description: Synchronise media as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: Ensure the AnkiWeb account is configured
media files are uploaded and downloaded as part of the sync; check progress in the sync notification

features.name: Enable automatic synchronisation
features.description: Enable automatic synchronisation as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: optionally restrict syncing to unmetered networks

features.name: Download shared decks
features.description: Download shared decks as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: browse or search the AnkiWeb shared deck site in the opened view

features.name: Import an .apkg or .colpkg file
features.description: Import an .apkg or .colpkg file as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: select the .apkg or .colpkg file from the picker

features.name: Import notes from a CSV/text file
features.description: Import notes from a CSV/text file as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: map the columns to the note-type fields
choose the target deck, the field separator and the duplicate handling

features.name: Export a deck or the whole collection
features.description: Export a deck or the whole collection as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap the gear icon on a deck
choose whether to include scheduling data and media

features.name: Create and manage note types
features.description: Create and manage note types as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap "+" to add a note type (clone or standard)
tap an existing type to rename it, edit its fields or edit its card templates

features.name: Edit card templates and styling
features.description: Edit card templates and styling as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: edit the front template, the back template and the shared styling CSS
tap the preview to check the result

features.name: Add or reorder note type fields
features.description: Add or reorder note type fields as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap "+" to add a field, drag to reorder, or tap a field to rename it and set its font, size, sort order and RTL flag

features.name: Use the whiteboard during review
features.description: Use the whiteboard during review as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: draw the answer with a finger or stylus
use the undo, eraser, colour and clear controls
tap the toggle again to hide it

features.name: Play card audio and use text to speech
features.description: Play card audio and use text to speech as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: During review, tap the replay-audio control to hear the attached audio; to have fields read aloud, open deck options or Settings
enable the text-to-speech/read-aloud option and select the voice and speed

features.name: Configure review gestures and controls
features.description: Configure review gestures and controls as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: assign an action (for example Show Answer, Answer Good, Undo, Bury, Edit) to each tap zone, swipe direction and hardware key

features.name: Configure reviewer appearance
features.description: Configure reviewer appearance as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: set the card font size and default font, the answer button placement, whether the timer and remaining counts are shown, and whether the screen stays on

features.name: Enable full screen review mode
features.description: Enable full screen review mode as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: choose the level (for example hide the status bar, hide the status bar and navigation bar)

features.name: Switch the app theme (including night mode)
features.description: Switch the app theme (including night mode) as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: choose the day theme, the night theme, and whether to follow the system setting

features.name: Set a deck study reminder notification
features.description: Set a deck study reminder notification as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: tap the gear icon on the deck
confirm. General notification behaviour is set in Settings

features.name: Configure the minimum card count for notifications
features.description: Configure the minimum card count for notifications as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: set the minimum number of due cards that triggers a notification and the vibration/blink options

features.name: Change the AnkiDroid collection folder
features.description: Change the AnkiDroid collection folder as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: confirm and restart the app when prompted

features.name: Create a backup of the collection
features.description: Create a backup of the collection as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: set the number of automatic backups to keep, or trigger a manual backup from the deck list overflow menu

features.name: Restore the collection from a backup
features.description: Restore the collection from a backup as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: select the backup file by date
confirm; the current collection is replaced

features.name: Check the database for errors
features.description: Check the database for errors as documented for AnkiDroid.

features.name: Check for unused or missing media
features.description: Check for unused or missing media as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: review the list of missing and unused files
tap the delete action to remove the unused files if wanted

features.name: Delete empty cards
features.description: Delete empty cards as documented for AnkiDroid.

features.name: Add the AnkiDroid home screen widget
features.description: Add the AnkiDroid home screen widget as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: Long-press an empty area of the Android home screen
drag the deck-picker or card-count widget onto the home screen
select the decks to display if prompted

features.name: Enable the AnkiDroid API for third-party apps
features.description: Enable the AnkiDroid API for third-party apps as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: enable the API/third-party app access option
grant the permission when another app requests it

features.name: Change the interface language
features.description: Change the interface language as documented for AnkiDroid.

features.name: View help, the manual and the about screen
features.description: View help, the manual and the about screen as documented for AnkiDroid.
actions: open the linked manual, the support page or the version and licence information
